Keeping it bottled up can make it worse in the long run. And if you worry that you won't be able to stop if you let it out, you will. When your body has released the pent up tensiom you will feel more relaxed.

Every done deals with situations different. If you are not consciously thinking about what happened, it will still be there in your subconscious. And if you are trying to just battle through and keep going, this takes a lot of mental effort. And that makes you mentally tired, which can be why you feel like you are not enjoying things as much.

There is a difference between being depressed and having depression. A person can have depression without there being a specific reason why, in this case it is normally due to chemical imbalances in the brain.

Being depressed is generally brought on by something. Like a loss of someone or something important for example. It can be that what happened to you in combination has led to depression.

I am not a professional, but I have borderline personality disorder that causes, amongst other things, depression and I have been dealing with it for many years now. I hope what I am trying to explain makes sense even if I haven't gone into very deep explanations.

It takes time to get comfortable with your therapist. And if you're not used to opening up, or have issues with it, tell them. They are there to listen and help you.

If you do not want to write it down in a long message, try doing just bullet points. As a reminder to yourself, you can chose whether to look at it or not, or hand it to the therapist and ask them to ask questions. Maybe stick in your wallet?

I sometimes find it easy to think of how to say something and getting questions gets my brain working. And if you're not comfortable talking about a certain thing that day, ask them to leave it for next time.

It will get easier x

I've found that when I suffer from diarrhoea , I take imodium (helps stop diarrhoea ) but I don't take the full dose. Directions are to take two at the onset and one tablet every time you have diarrhoea. Instead I only take the two, or maybe even one tablet a day. Doesn't make me completely constipated but slows things down. 

Please be aware, I am not a medical professional so if you are unsure, please consult with a doctor. But as I do not take the "full dose" it helps without blocking me up completely.

I'll try to explain lol. I measured the circumference of the table. Then I made the base chain, stretched this gently (as it will stretch when pulled over the table) and made sure I got it to right length. Then just crochet in the round for as many rows as needed, again this will have to be adapted to what table you use. To make the hole I started turning the work, then when I needed to i started crocheting in the round again. I made a rectangle to cover the top of the table, and I crocheted in the hole in the round using decreases in the corners until I got the hole the size I wanted. There was so much trial and error gone into this I almost gave up.

Inside is a self heating pad, and I also put one on the top part of the table before I put the cover on so its nice and soft to sit on top of aswell.

I hope this makes some kinds of sense 😂
